verdict: Paid ads remain off; Google Business Profile needs urgent attention now.
narrative: Both Meta and Google Ads carried zero spend and zero leads across the full 28-day window, so every engagement this period came from organic sources. Your Google Business Profile delivered 150 actions over the month — 49 calls and 101 website clicks — but activity fell 87.5% in the last 7 days, dropping to zero actions on August 25–27, which is a confirmed and material drop requiring immediate investigation. Organic search interest is actually rising (search clicks up 37.7% week over week), meaning real intent exists but no channel is currently capturing it. The GBP profile is being reviewed now to identify and resolve whatever triggered the visibility loss, and paid campaigns are being prepared to go live so that incoming search demand begins converting into leads.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions (calls + website clicks) in the last 28 days — the sole active channel this period
Drop in Google Business Profile activity over the last 7 days, hitting zero actions on the final three days
Rise in organic search clicks week over week, confirming demand exists that paid campaigns are not yet capturing

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile activity collapsed to zero in the last three days, risking a sustained loss of local search visibility.
watch_item.fix: The profile is being audited this week to identify the cause and restore normal activity before the drop compounds.
